features:
Key Features:

10 g of Protein per Bar: Sourced from soy protein isolate and almonds, supporting muscle recovery and prolonged fullness.

Approximately 5 g Dietary Fiber: Helps with digestion and sustained energy.

Whole-Grain Oats: Primary ingredient for slow-digesting carbohydrates and nutrients.

Crunchy Texture with Nut Bits: Includes almonds for added crunch and flavor.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for people with gluten intolerance or those choosing gluten-free options.

No Artificial Flavors or High‑Fructose Corn Syrup: Clean formulation designed for mindful snacking.

Benefits:

Helps Manage Hunger: Protein and fiber work together to reduce cravings and bridge between meals.

Flavorful Energy: Sweet honey flavor and nutty texture offer a satisfying, wholesome taste.

Portable & Convenient: Individually wrapped—ideal for travel, lunch boxes, or post-workout fuel.

Better Snack Choice: Made with real ingredients, offering nutrition beyond candy bars or simple granola bars.

Supports Active Lifestyles: Designed to provide energy and satiety whether you're on-the-go or working out.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Soy Protein Isolate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Honey, Molasses, Rice Starch, Soy Lecithin, Baking Soda, Salt, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.
